'''L1V-IN''' was an [[IN-4 information droid]]. Circa [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[operative]]s used L1V-IN as a blind drop for passing along confidential messages at the [[Kuat Passenger Port]], but their cover was blown when [[Do'naal]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]], discovered their system. The Empire secretly [[Programmer/Legends|reprogrammed]] L1V-IN, which led to the capture of Rebel agent [[Rixen]].
